categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies AddrMan connection tracking in src/addrman.cpp and src/addrman_impl.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes with partial network outages from improperly penalizing valid peers and halting address relay. As described, global `m_last_good` tracking means 'successful connections on IPv4 update m_last_good across all networks', causing failed attempts on an unreachable network (like Tor or IPv6) to mark remote addresses as terrible despite the fault being purely local.
